Name: Custom Dungeon Floors
Author: aedenthorn
Description:
This mod now lets you customize all floor types in the mines and Skull Cave. Currently it lets you customize the following:

[list]
[*]How often a floor is a monster-infested floor, and what type
[*]How often a floor is a treasure chest floor
[*]How many monsters appear on each type of floor
[*]How many pickupable items appear on each type of floor
[*]How many gemstones appear on regular floors
[*]How many stone appear on regular floors
[*]How often a stone is a purple (gem-dropping) stone
[*]How often a stone is a mystic stone
[*]How often a stone is some type of ore
[*]How often ore is each type of ore
[*]How many weeds and ice crystals spawn
[*]How often a stone has a ladder under it (if there is no ladder in the level yet)
[*]How often a ladder under a stone is a mine shaft instead
[/list]

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]

You customize the dungeons by editing the config.json file in this mod's folder (it will be created automatically the first time you open the game).

[b]Config Explanation:[/b]

[list]
[*][b]EnableMod[/b] setting to false turns off the mod.
[*][b]EnableFloorTypeChanges[/b] setting to false turns off all changes to floor types.
[*][b]EnableTileChanges[/b] setting to false turns off all changes to tiles (stones, ores, weeds, ladders, shafts).
[*][b]PercentChanceMonsterFloor[/b] is the chance that a given floor will be any of the three types of monster floor ([b]between 0 and 100[/b])
[*][b]PercentChanceMonsterFloor[/b] is the chance that a given floor will be any of the three types of monster floor ([b]between 0 and 100[/b])
[*][b]SlimeDinoMonsterSplitPercents[/b] decides between the three types of monster floors for Skull Cave [b](should add up to 100)[/b]
[*][b]SlimeMonsterSplitPercents[/b] decides between slime floors or just monster infested floors for the mines [b] (should add up to 100)[/b]
[*][b]MinFloorsBetweenMonsterFloors[/b] sets the minimum number of ordinary floors between each of the monster floors regardless of the other settings
[*][b]TreasureChestFloorMultiplier[/b] multiplies the chance of a floor being a treasure chest floor by this number
[*][b]MinFloorsBetweenTreasureFloors[/b] sets the minimum number of ordinary floors between each treasure chest floor regardless of the above multiplier
[*][b]MonsterMultiplierOn{TYPE}Floors[/b] multiplies ﻿the monster spawn chance per tile on {TYPE} floors by this number
[*][b]ItemMultiplierOn{TYPE}Floors[/b] multiplies the pickupable item spawn chance per tile on {TYPE} floors by this number
[*][b]StoneMultiplierOnRegularFloors[/b] multiplies the stone spawn chance per tile on regular floors by this number
[*][b]GemstoneMultiplierOnRegularFloors[/b] multiplies the gemstone spawn chance per tile on regular floors by this number
[*][b]PurpleStoneMultiplier[/b] multiplies the chance of a stone being a purple (gem-producing) stone by this number
[*][b]MysticStoneMultiplier[/b] multiplies the chance of a stone being a mystic stone by this number
[*][b]ResourceClumpChance[/b] sets the boulder or custom resource clump chance
[*][b]ChanceForOresMultiplierInMines [/b]multiplies the chance of a stone being the level-appropriate type of ore in the mines
[*][b]ChanceForOreMultiplier[/b] multiplies the chance of a stone being some type of ore by this number (Skull Cave only)
[*][b]ChanceForIridiumMultiplier[/b] multiplies the chance of ore being iridium by this number (Skull Cave only)
[*][b]ChanceForGoldMultiplier[/b] multiplies the chance of ore being gold (if not iridium) by this number (Skull Cave only)
[*][b]ChanceForIronMultiplier[/b] multiplies the chance of ore being iron (if not iridium or gold) by this number (Skull Cave only)
[*][b]WeedsChance[/b] chance for weeds or crystals spawning in the mines (0.0 to 1.0)
[*][b]WeedsMultiplier[/b] multiplies the range of how many weeds or ice crystals try to spawn per cluster (without multiplying, the range is 7 to 23).
[*]﻿[b]ChanceForLadderInStoneMultiplier[/b] multiplies the chance of a stone having a ladder or shaft under it by this number (if there hasn't been one yet)
[*]﻿[b]ChanceLadderIsShaftMultiplier[/b] multiplies chance of a ladder being a shaft instead by this number﻿ (if there hasn't been one yet)
[/list]
Chances can now be decimal values, except for the three percent ones.
